result.title: Bellman Contraction under MMD: A Unified Framework
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 88 pages, 18 figures, 13 tables
result.summary: We introduce a mathematical framework for studying contraction of the distributional Bellman operator under Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD). We show that contraction reduces to conditional positive definiteness of an associated kernel constructed from the base kernel, which we call the Bellman difference kernel. Focusing on radial kernels, we use Schoenberg's theorem to connect this condition to Bernstein functions. This gives contraction criteria that hold in any dimension and can be verified analytically or tested numerically. Our framework unifies known results for the Gaussian RBF, power-distance, and multiquadric kernels. A numerical search identifies 11 new kernels that induce contraction. We also propose chaining, a general construction that produces kernels inducing contraction with any prescribed factor. To reconcile theory with practice, we show that contraction on a set only requires conditional positive definiteness on that set. This explains why the RBF kernel can remain a valid choice when rewards are bounded, despite its lack of global contraction. Finally, we identify a fundamental tradeoff between contraction rate and discriminative power, where kernels that contract faster tend to discriminate less between distributions. Code is available at https://github.com/BaptisteDebes/BellmanContractionMMD

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 MMD 下分布 Bellman 算子的收缩性，把收缩归结为由基核构造的 Bellman difference kernel 的条件正定性，借助 Schoenberg 定理与 Bernstein 函数给出任意维度可解析或数值检验的判据，统一 RBF、power-distance、multiquadric 等已知结果，数值搜索得到 11 个新核，并提出 chaining 构造与收缩率—判别力权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 核的「收缩率与判别力不可兼得」及局部集合上的收缩判据，可能为 latent 状态分布比较的度量选择、循环/迭代式 latent 更新的稳定性与收敛性分析提供核查线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
